subject: Marketplace private offer: multi-entity payor mapping and entitlement sequencing
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@cloudresellco.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Private offer prep - Acme Retail (multi-entity customer)

Jonas —

Thanks for taking this. We're kicking off the CPPO for Acme Retail but hit a mapping snag: Acme has three legal entities across NA (Acme US, Acme Holdings, Acme Supply) and their procurement wants the invoice to route to the correct payor based on SKU groups. AWS needs the reseller payor mapping + entitlement sequencing before they can create the Channel Partner Private Offer.

I attached a quick CSV that shows the current mapping Acme sent. Can you confirm Redwood can support per-entity payor routing for the same CPPO (one offer with multiple bill-to mappings)? If not, we need to propose a workaround (multiple offers vs consolidated invoice).

Next steps we need from Redwood:
- Confirm CPPO entity mapping capability and any limits (SKUs per payor)
- Owner on Redwood side for entitlement matrix review
- Target dates: Acme needs CPPO live by 2026-12-10 to align with their procurement window

FWIW, AWS PS / Anita is happy to facilitate the CPPO creation once the mapping file and entitlement matrix are final.

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Channel Sales, CloudResellCo
[Attachment: acme-payor-map.csv (text/csv)]
From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>

Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, markus.klein@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private offer prep - Acme Retail (multi-entity customer)

Alex —

Appreciate the quick context and the CSV. Short answer: we can support per-entity billing for CPPO flows but there are operational nuances to be aware of (and a couple of gating items from our billing provider).

High-level plan from Redwood: 
1) Entitlement matrix: marissa will own validating SKU -> entitlement grouping alignment (required before CPPO submission).
2) Payor mapping: ben will validate the CSV and translate to the AWS CPPO payor schema (we need full legal names + tax IDs).
3) Rollout/activation: markus will coordinate the activation window and fallback route if AWS requests separate offers.

Can you: 
- Confirm the three legal entity full names + tax IDs (if available) in the CSV?
- Confirm whether Acme expects a single DocuSign signature or per-entity sign-off.

Tentative timeline:
- Today: internal validation and ask clarifying questions
- 2026-12-01: final mapping + entitlement matrix submitted to AWS
- 2026-12-07: CPPO created by AWS & partner validation
- 2026-12-10: target go-live

I'll leave details to ben/marissa for technical items. If needed we can schedule a 30-min runbook call with Anita and Acme procurement tomorrow.

—Jonas
Head of Channel Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Alex/Jonas —

I reviewed the CSV and sketched an entitlement matrix (attached) that matches Acme's SKU groups to Redwood product SKUs. Notes: 
- We can do per-entity payor routing within a single CPPO as long as each entity has a separate tax ID and billing contact. AWS requires the mapping in the exact JSON schema; I've exported our translation in the attached Excel.
- If Acme cannot provide tax IDs, AWS may insist on separate offers per entity — which adds lead time and complicates co-sell attribution.

Action items for Acme (please confirm):
1) Provide legal entity full names and tax IDs for: Acme US, Acme Holdings, Acme Supply
2) Confirm invoicing preference (single consolidated invoice or separate invoices per entity)
3) Confirm signer(s) for DocuSign — we can proceed with a single corporate signatory if they authorize cross-entity billing.

Attachment: cp-po-entitlement-matrix.xlsx

I also created a stub DocuSign link (below) for the CPPO activation paperwork — I will not send until we have final mapping.
[Attachment: docusign-cppo-activation-link.txt]

—Ben Carter
Head of Cloud Marketplace, Redwood Inference

Team —

Thanks for the thread and the draft matrix. AWS can support multiple payor mappings on a single CPPO as long as the mapping file adheres to the CPPO schema and each entity has the required tax and contact fields. A few operational notes from our side: 
- Please include EIN/VAT numbers where applicable; blank tax IDs trigger manual review and can add 7–10 days.
- For entitlement sequencing, indicate if a SKU should be billed to a fallback payor (we support fallback ordering).
- DocuSign: AWS needs the partner (CloudResellCo) to confirm acceptance before we finalize the offer. Either a single signatory with cross-entity authorization or per-entity signers are acceptable.

I'll standby for the finalized mapping + Ben's export. Once we have that, I can queue CPPO creation; expect 48–72 hours for AWS-side processing barring manual reviews.

Best,
Anita Gupta
AWS Marketplace Partner Success
